known_issues.issue: History Recall only covers history targets
known_issues.detail: The champion candidate B2_HISTORY_RECALL can only rank items already in a user's history.

known_issues.issue: Novel targets are the majority and History Recall scores 0 there
known_issues.detail: Most test targets are novel items; on that majority slice the deployed model has zero recall.

known_issues.issue: candidate_recall@10 and hit_rate@10 are semantically identical
known_issues.detail: The evaluator computes both with the same computation, so they cannot be used as independent signals.

known_issues.issue: Retrieval and ranking failure are not mutually exclusive
known_issues.detail: The failure attribution does not separate pool-miss from rank-miss; diagnoses can double-count.
The blended score collapsed onto the popularity signal; blending added nothing.

known_issues.issue: Candidate Ranker was not a true candidate-level LambdaRank
known_issues.detail: No candidate-level learning-to-rank model (e.g. lightgbm) was available; the ranker was a heuristic stand-in.
Bucket-specialist reranking reproduced the popularity ordering instead of bucket-specific orderings.

known_issues.issue: Dense full user x item matrix caused a 3.35GiB allocation failure
known_issues.detail: Materializing the dense score matrix in float64 blew the memory budget mid-round.
Loop stopped at 1807.57s of the 7200s budget (wall_clock_seconds=1807.570787 in fcf5ad3dbcdf9700dd644eff run_manifest).
